title: Navy Secretary Kimball and Admiral Radford's planes circled by an object

tellings.quote: was Kimble's plane and Radford's plane were both accosted by an object that circled around their aircraft.

plain: In 1950, on a flight from California to Hawaii, an unknown object is said to have circled two planes: one carrying Dan Kimball, the Secretary of the Navy, and one carrying the admiral Arthur Radford. A guest named Richard Dolan tells it to Michels, passing on an account he credits to a man named Donald Kho. If true, it would mean the Navy's own top leaders had a close encounter of their own.
